ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and other potential cases.
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How many cases are currently being investigated?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Medicaid programs. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and programs.
